optimizedDescription.value: Extensible pure registry resolves immutable built-ins and namespaced plugin checks with locked binding governance.

optimizedContext.value:
# Check Registry

## Rules
- `CheckRegistry` catalogs `Check` definitions and default `CheckBinding`; exposes `get`, `has`, `list`, `bindings`.
- Built-ins immutable. `register(pluginName, check, ...)` uses canonical `@${pluginName}.${check.id}` and rejects invalid names/duplicates/kinds.
- Bindings identify transition, archive, or step-skip coordinates; exact duplicate fails.
- Governance separates placement, binding policy, config, disablement. Code locks are monotonic; schema-owned bindings remain editable within check locks.
- Categories A/B restrict embedding/override/disable; policy checks permit governed overrides. Resolver merges check -> binding -> schema config.

## Constraints
- Pure domain: no filesystem, subprocess, console.
- Existing built-in resolution remains compatible.
- Checks and bindings immutable after construction.
